manifest.name: Filesystem
manifest.description: Let Claude access your filesystem to read and write files.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text. DEPRECATED: Use read_text_file instead.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file. Use the 'head' parameter to read only the first N lines of a file, or the 'tail' parameter to read only the last N lines of a file. Operates on the file as text regardless of extension. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: read_media_file
tools.description: Read an image or audio file. Returns the base64 encoded data and MIME type. Only works within allowed directories.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Directories
allowed_directories.description: Select directories the filesystem server can access

manifest.name: panos-mcp
manifest.description: Control Palo Alto Networks PA-Series firewalls and Panorama with AI. 117 tools across 16 modules: security policies, NAT, objects, VPN, logs, WildFire, GlobalProtect, decryption, and more. Supports staged commits and read-only inspection. For multi-firewall setups use the CLI mode — see github.com/apius-tech/Palo-MCP.

tools.name: get_firewall_info
tools.description: Retrieves system information from the PanOS firewall

tools.name: get_ha_status
tools.description: Retrieves high-availability state and peer information

tools.name: get_active_sessions
tools.description: Retrieves active session count and summary

host.title: Firewall Host
host.description: PanOS firewall or Panorama hostname or IP address

manifest.name: pdf-viewer
manifest.description: Read, annotate, and interact with PDF files — interactive viewer with search, navigation, annotations, form filling, and text extraction

tools.name: list_pdfs
tools.description: List available PDF files that can be displayed

tools.name: display_pdf
tools.description: Display an interactive PDF viewer with search and navigation

tools.name: interact
tools.description: Interact with the PDF viewer — navigate, annotate, highlight text, fill forms, extract pages

pdf_directories.title: PDF Directories
pdf_directories.description: Folders the PDF viewer may list and open PDFs from
